name: Midorigafuchi Yotogi no Mura no Oyome-sama
original_name: 碧ヶ淵 夜伽の村のお嫁様
source:
Main character's mother dies, and relatives arrive for her funeral. That evening niece comes to his room and starts hugging. Due to special air in the room protagonist can not resist and robs her of virginity - that in addition to an affair with another relative he was having. Then comes the third girl, and all of them turn out to be bride candidates. Protagonist needs to live with the for seven days to determine the best bride for himself.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的母亲去世了，亲戚们来参加她的葬礼。那天晚上，侄女来到他的房间并开始拥抱。由于房间里的特殊空气，主角无法抗拒并剥夺了她的童贞 - 除了他与另一位亲戚的婚外情之外。接下来是第三个女孩，她们都是新娘候选人。主角需要和新娘一起生活7天，才能为自己选出最好的新娘。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
